name: MC Extremo DeathSound
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Tontoque28
description: A Forge 1.20.1 modification that plays a custom sound effect upon death and alters the game's text components to display death messages in red, bold text with skull symbols in both the chat and the main death screen.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
